content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Classification: deviation (fallback cure proposed).**

Section 13.5 is a Customer-payable liquidated damages characterisation covering two fees, each priced as a percentage of the Estimated Remaining Value (i.e. remaining-term value), with the Termination for Cause Fee triggered by any Event of Default — failing the preferred position and the fallback, and edging into walk-away territory.

Because deleting the fees entirely would require rewriting the exit mechanics (owned by T4C), I took the fallback with three surgical edits:
1. **11.1** — the fee amount becomes "not to exceed three (3) months of Fees" (fallback cap).
2. **11.2(A)** — the separate remaining-value Termination for Cause Fee is folded into the same Termination for Convenience Fee, and the now-dangling defined-term sentence is removed.
3. **13.5** — recast so that this early-termination fee is the sole liquidated amount payable by us and no other Customer payment is liquidated damages or a penalty.

Notice periods and instalment timing were left untouched so the exit mechanics are not redlined twice.
